summary: Iter 322 — Verified WM-02 Reservation-without-Cut, P03 Durable Posting, and P06 Remaining Receiving (AX-08/WM-03/04/05/09, IX-09). PendingCutsPanel and PutawayOrdersPanel data-testids match spec (pending-cut-actual/waste/confirm-<rid>, pa-confirm-manual-<id>).
